11-alice-s-adventures-in-wonderland.description: A book by Lewis Carroll. The rabbit-hole went straight on like a tunnel for some way, and then dipped suddenly down, so suddenly that Alice had not a moment to think about stopping herself before she found herself falling down a very deep well.

arxiv-2108-10561.creator: Control Neural Conversational Models
arxiv-2108-10561.description: Abstract Contents List of Figures List of Tables Taming the Beast: Learning to Control Neural Conversational Models by Andrea Madotto Department of Electronic and Computer Engineering The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology Abstract This thesis investigates the controllability of deep learning-based, end-to-end, generative dialogue systems in both task-oriented and chit-chat scenarios.

arxiv-2112-08712.title: The Schwarzian derivative and Euler–Lagrange equations Thanks: Partially supported by the grant 2019/34/E/ST1/00188 from the National Science Centre, Poland.
arxiv-2112-08712.creator: Wojciech Kryński
arxiv-2112-08712.description: Abstract . We study the Schwarzian derivative from a variational viewpoint. Firstly we show that the Schwarzian derivative defines a first integral of the Euler–Lagrange equation of a second order Lagrangian. Secondly, we show that the Schwarzian derivative itself is the Euler–Lagrange operator for an appropriately chosen class of variations. 1.

arxiv-2307-13194.title: The eighth moment of Dirichlet L L -functions II
arxiv-2307-13194.creator: Vorrapan Chandee, Xiannan Li, Kaisa Matomäki, Maksym Radziwiłł
arxiv-2307-13194.description: Abstract . We prove an asymptotic formula for the eighth moment of Dirichlet L L -functions averaged over primitive characters χ \chi modulo q q , over all moduli q ≤ Q q\leq Q and with a short average on the critical line. Previously the same result was shown conditionally on the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis by the first two authors.

arxiv-2403-14246.title: CATSE: A Context-Aware Framework for Causal Target Sound Extraction Thanks: Work performed while Shrishail Baligar was a Co-op at Bose Corporation.
arxiv-2403-14246.creator: Shrishail Baligar 1,2 , Mikolaj Kegler 2 , Bryce Irvin 2 , Marko Stamenovic 2 , Shawn Newsam 1
arxiv-2403-14246.description: Abstract Target Sound Extraction (TSE) focuses on the problem of separating sources of interest, indicated by a user’s cue, from the input mixture. Most existing solutions operate in an offline fashion and are not suited to the low-latency causal processing constraints imposed by applications in live-streamed content such as augmented hearing.

arxiv-2405-10873.title: Light-matter interaction at rough surfaces: a morphological perspective on laser-induced periodic surface structures
arxiv-2405-10873.creator: Vladimir Yu. Fedorov, Jean-Philippe Colombier
arxiv-2405-10873.description: Abstract We use ab-initio electromagnetic simulations to investigate light absorption by rough surfaces in the context of the formation of laser-induced periodic surface structures. Our approach involves modeling a realistic rough surface using a statistical description of its continuous height distribution via a corresponding correlation function.

arxiv-2408-11053.title: Revisiting VerilogEval: A Year of Improvements in Large-Language Models for Hardware Code Generation
arxiv-2408-11053.creator: Nathaniel Pinckney, Christopher Batten, Mingjie Liu, Haoxing Ren, Brucek Khailany
arxiv-2408-11053.description: Abstract . The application of large-language models (LLMs) to digital hardware code generation is an emerging field, with most LLMs primarily trained on natural language and software code. Hardware code like Verilog constitutes a small portion of training data, and few hardware benchmarks exist.

Intermittent preventive treatment for malaria in children (IPTc) is a promising new intervention for the prevention of malaria but its delivery is a challenge. pmc-10566539.title: The landscape of microRNA interaction annotation: analysis of three rare disorders as a case study
pmc-10566539.creator: Simona Panni, Kalpana Panneerselvam, Pablo Porras, Margaret Duesbury, Livia Perfetto, Luana Licata, Henning Hermjakob, Sandra Orchard
pmc-10566539.description: In recent years, a huge amount of data on ncRNA interactions has been described in scientific papers and databases. Although considerable effort has been made to annotate the available knowledge in public repositories, there are still significant discrepancies in how different resources capture and interpret data on ncRNA functional and physical associations.

pmc-10666093.title: Unfolding sustainability transitions in food systems: Insights from UK and French trajectories
pmc-10666093.creator: Claire Lamine, Terry Marsden
pmc-10666093.description: While the negative environmental, social and health impacts of the current food system have been acknowledged and evidenced for several decades, the recent and current transformations in food systems at diverse scales are not yet addressing the many inter-related stakes at play.

pmc-10775159.creator: Unknown
pmc-10775159.description: r, I think of 3 questions: first, does having breast cancer increase your risk of developing lung cancer? Second, is it the radiation—does radiation increase your risk of developing lung cancer and, if so, when, is it early or is it late?

pmc-11481592.title: A case report of acute myocardial infarction with hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia
pmc-11481592.creator: Wenping Xue, Wei Qin, Tingting Liu, Weichao Shan
pmc-11481592.description: Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT) is an autosomal dominant disorder characterized by epistaxis, gastrointestinal bleeding, iron deficiency anemia, and arteriovenous malformations (AVMs) affecting the lungs, liver, and brain. Owing to its rarity and diagnostic challenges, early identification is often elusive. Underdiagnosis and prolonged diagnostic delays are prevalent.

pmc-12586908.title: The Relation Between Goal‐Predictive Gaze Behavior and Imitation—A Live Eye‐Tracking Study in 12‐Month‐Olds
pmc-12586908.creator: Franziska Sieber, Jan Czarnomski, Moritz M Daum, Norbert Zmyj
pmc-12586908.description: Children learn from others by imitating observed behavior. According to some theorists, to imitate an agent's action, infants need to identify the agent's action goal. To test this assumption, goal‐predictive gaze shifts of 104 German 12‐month‐olds (57 female) were measured using live eye‐tracking. These goal‐predictive gaze shifts were related to their imitation of an action performed by a live model.

pmc-12716833.title: Internet Memes as Drivers of Health Narratives and Infodemics: Integrative Review
pmc-12716833.creator: Alvaro Carmona Pestaña, Iván Herrera-Peco, Beatriz Jiménez-Gómez, Carolina Suárez-Llevat
pmc-12716833.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDigital media memes have emerged as influential tools in health communication, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic. While they offer opportunities for emotional engagement and community resilience, they also act as vectors for health misinformation, contributing to the global infodemic.

pmc-12803430.title: Mitral Annular Disjunction Presenting With Ventricular Arrhythmia: A Case Report
pmc-12803430.creator: Oumaima Taoussi, Hajar Rabii, Soukaina Scadi, Fatimazahra Merzouk, Ghali Benouna
pmc-12803430.description: Mitral annular disjunction (MAD) is an underrecognized structural abnormality increasingly linked to ventricular arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death. We report the case of a patient admitted for palpitations and chest discomfort, in whom a 12-lead surface electrocardiogram captured a short episode of ventricular tachycardia that terminated spontaneously, consistent with non-sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT).

pmc-13054974.title: The prognostic value analysis of PIV, PLR, LMR, NPR, and NLR in hilar cholangiocarcinoma
pmc-13054974.creator: Hongyang Guo, Xueyan Bai, Jin Shi, Zhen Liu, Zhaoyang Hu
pmc-13054974.description: BackgroundHilar cholangiocarcinoma (HCCA) has a high propensity for early recurrence. We evaluated the prognostic value of preoperative inflammatory biomarkers, Pan‑Immunological Value (PIV), Platelet‑Lymphocyte Ratio (PLR), Lymphocyte‑Monocyte Ratio (LMR), Neutrophil‑Platelet Ratio (NPR), and Neutrophil‑Lymphocyte Ratio (NLR), in resected HCCA.MethodsA retrospective cohort study included 373 HCCA patients undergoing radical resection from January 2017 to May 2022.

pmc-13222872.title: Effectiveness of Community-Based Breast Cancer Screening Using Full-Field Digital Mammography With Digital Breast Tomosynthesis in an Urban Population in Central India: An Observational Study
pmc-13222872.creator: Shilpa Pande, Sanjay Dakhore, Deepshikha Arora, Shashikant Juvekar
pmc-13222872.description: BackgroundBreast cancer is the most common malignancy among women worldwide and remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality. In India, delayed presentation and limited access to organised screening programmes contribute to poorer outcomes. Community-based screening models, combined with advanced imaging techniques, may improve early detection.

pmc-13232015.title: Maternal opioid use and hepatitis C infection disrupt the placental immune landscape and structure
pmc-13232015.creator: Heather E. True, Brianna M. Doratt, Sheridan B. Wagner, Delphine C. Malherbe, Nathan R. Shelman, Mahdi Eskandarian Boroujeni, Cynthia Cockerham, John M. O’Brien, Ilhem Messaoudi
pmc-13232015.description: Maternal opioid use disorder (OUD) poses substantial risks to maternal and fetal health. These adverse outcomes are believed to be mediated, in part, by changes in placental structure and function; however, few studies have addressed this question. Here, we utilized flow cytometry, histology, and spatial and single-cell transcriptomics to uncover the impact of OUD on placental tissues.

pmc-13327469.title: UGT1A1 Fragment Analysis: Genotyping the (TA)n Variable Repeat Polymorphism for Clinical Applications
pmc-13327469.creator: Ryan N. Baugher, Kristen M. Pike, Teri M. Plona, Stephanie D. Mellott, Todd B. Young, Heidi E. Lawhorn, Stephen M. Hewitt
pmc-13327469.description: Background UGT1A1 is involved in glucuronidation of drugs and plays a large role in metabolism. Genotyping variants of differing dinucleotide TA repeat length within the TATA box of the UGT1A1 region (dbSNP ID rs3064744) are utilized in the dosing of irinotecan and atazanavir for pharmacogenomics purposes.
